title: Apple (AAPL) Shares Sold by Albion Financial Group UT
text:
Posted by Joyce Ramirez on Mar 31st, 2018 // No Comments 
Albion Financial Group UT lowered its stake in shares of Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 2.0% during the 3rd quarter, according to the company in its most recent Form 13F filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). The fund owned 90,709 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 1,824 shares during the period. Apple accounts for about 2.1% of Albion Financial Group UT’s investment portfolio, making the stock its 9th largest position. Albion Financial Group UT’s holdings in Apple were worth $13,980,000 as of its most recent filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). 
Other institutional investors also recently added to or reduced their stakes in the company. Janus Henderson Group PLC increased its position in Apple by 301.3% during the second quarter. Janus Henderson Group PLC now owns 20,003,587 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $2,880,992,000 after acquiring an additional 15,018,790 shares during the last quarter. Capital Research Global Investors boosted its stake in shares of Apple by 15.0% during the second quarter. Capital Research Global Investors now owns 29,449,961 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $4,241,383,000 after purchasing an additional 3,845,363 shares during the period. Arrowstreet Capital Limited Partnership boosted its stake in shares of Apple by 200.3% during the second quarter. Arrowstreet Capital Limited Partnership now owns 4,765,574 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $686,338,000 after purchasing an additional 3,178,809 shares during the period. Principal Financial Group Inc. boosted its stake in shares of Apple by 25.3% during the second quarter. Principal Financial Group Inc. now owns 10,582,632 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $1,524,110,000 after purchasing an additional 2,138,928 shares during the period. Finally, Parametric Portfolio Associates LLC boosted its stake in shares of Apple by 21.6% during the second quarter. Parametric Portfolio Associates LLC now owns 11,991,909 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $1,727,075,000 after purchasing an additional 2,132,900 shares during the period. In other news, insider Daniel J. Riccio sold 15,641 shares of the company’s stock in a transaction dated Friday, January 5th. The shares were sold at an average price of $174.78, for a total transaction of $2,733,733.98. Following the transaction, the insider now owns 13,739 shares in the company, valued at $2,401,302.42. The transaction was disclosed in a filing with the SEC, which is accessible through this hyperlink . Corporate insiders own 0.08% of the company’s stock. 
Shares of AAPL stock traded up $1.30 during mid-day trading on Friday, hitting $167.78. 38,398,505 shares of the stock traded hands, compared to its average volume of 37,725,965. The firm has a market cap of $851,317.94, a price-to-earnings ratio of 18.22, a PEG ratio of 1.27 and a beta of 1.19. Apple has a 52-week low of $140.06 and a 52-week high of $183.50. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.74, a quick ratio of 1.20 and a current ratio of 1.24. 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last released its quarterly earnings results on Thursday, February 1st. The iPhone maker reported $3.89 EPS for the quarter, beating the Thomson Reuters’ consensus estimate of $3.82 by $0.07. Apple had a net margin of 21.13% and a return on equity of 37.37%. The business had revenue of $88.29 billion during the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $87.62 billion. During the same period in the prior year, the firm posted $3.36 earnings per share. The company’s quarterly revenue was up 12.7% on a year-over-year basis. equities analysts predict that Apple will post 11.37 earnings per share for the current fiscal year. 
A number of analysts have recently issued reports on AAPL shares. Rosenblatt Securities set a $180.00 target price on shares of Apple and gave the company a “buy” rating in a research note on Tuesday, December 26th. Loop Capital reissued a “buy” rating and set a $200.00 target price on shares of Apple in a research note on Friday, December 22nd. BMO Capital Markets reissued a “buy” rating and set a $199.00 target price on shares of Apple in a research note on Wednesday, December 20th. Citigroup reissued a “buy” rating and set a $200.00 target price on shares of Apple in a research note on Wednesday, December 13th. Finally, KeyCorp reissued a “buy” rating and set a $192.00 target price on shares of Apple in a research note on Thursday, December 7th. One research analyst has rated the stock with a sell rating, seventeen have issued a hold rating, thirty-two have issued a buy rating and one has assigned a strong buy rating to the stock. The stock presently has an average rating of “Buy” and a consensus target price of $202.62.
